=== AWS === (release notes NOT moved; harness-security AUDITED this scan)
aws_agentcore_releasenotes: September 2026 = 5 items (UNCHANGED from 9/23). Literal list:
  1. Harness: Interactive shells (terminals)        (reported 9/23)
  2. Harness: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints     (reported 9/22)
  3. Harness: Lifecycle hooks                        (reported 9/22)
  4. Evaluations: TypeScript agent framework support (reported earlier)
  5. Consent Portal for AgentCore Identity           (reported earlier)
  August 2026 = 8 items (Agent Registry GA+CMK; Memory IngestData; Memory flexible
    namespaces; Agent Registry PrivateLink; Agent Registry RAM cross-account sharing;
    Payments Coinbase-via-Marketplace; Memory non-conversational JSON; Evaluations
    skill evaluators) — all previously reported.
harness-security: AUDITED 2026-09-24. Two findings filed. Key literal facts:
  * additionalParams / apiBase / modelId on InvokeHarness are passed to the model provider
    UNVALIDATED. Documented abuses: LiteLLM aws_bedrock_runtime_endpoint redirects the
    SIGNED SigV4 request + session credentials to an arbitrary endpoint; OpenAI
    extra_headers overrides Authorization; LiteLLM aws_role_name attempts sts:AssumeRole;
    modelId/apiBase redirect inference to another model/region/provider.
  * `skills` field overridable PER INVOCATION -> arbitrary S3/Git source; harness treats
    all skill content as TRUSTED input, no validation/sanitization.
  * harness REJECTS toolUse blocks in the final InvokeHarness message (server-side).
    Non-harness AgentCore Runtime has NO such server-side protection.
  * toolResult IS accepted in the final message; inline-function handoffs resume by
    runtimeSessionId.
  * PAIRED IAM MODEL: InvokeHarness needs InvokeHarness + InvokeAgentRuntime;
    CreateHarness needs CreateHarness + CreateAgentRuntime + CreateMemory; Update/Delete
    likewise. Full table of 14 harness APIs captured in the report.
  * NEW RESOURCE TYPE: arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:<r>:<a>:harness/<id>/harness-endpoint/<name>
  * SigV4 callers get NO per-user identity propagation downstream — Token Vault user-scoped
    OAuth + on-behalf-of exchange only work via inbound OAuth Bearer JWT.
  * Execution-role reach: bedrock:InvokeModel *, ECR public+private, X-Ray, CloudWatch,
    GetWorkloadAccessToken(ForJWT), Browser (7 actions), Code Interpreter (5), Memory (5),
    GetResourceApiKey + secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, GetResourceOauth2Token,
    InvokeGateway, s3:GetObject for skills, lambda:InvokeFunction / sns:Publish /
    events:PutEvents for lifecycle hooks.
  UNAUDITED harness subpages (3rd carry — NOW HALF DONE, sweep the rest):
    harness-skills, harness-memory, harness-environment, harness-versioning,
    harness-export, harness-operations
aws_bedrock_changelog: newest 2026-09-21 = cross-model tokens-per-day quota. UNCHANGED.
aws_q_*: not fetched. Dead. Retirement still recommended.

  (was 2026-09-10 Projects).  [NEW — 2 FINDINGS REPORTED]
  Rollouts: monitor per PR; reads diff + touched systems; writes monitoring plan as PR
    comment; wakes on deploy events; runs plan against logs/metrics/traces; per-environment
    verdict = verified healthy | regression detected | inconclusive; on regression names
    suspected change, notifies author, CAN OPEN A REVERT PR or hand off to a cloud agent.
    Integrations: Origin/GitHub, CD system, Datadog / Grafana / Honeycomb. Teams+Enterprise.
    *** NO /docs/rollouts PAGE — 404 as of this scan. Only the changelog permalink
        https://cursor.com/changelog/rollouts-and-security-reviewer. Re-check for a docs
        page next scan. ***
  Security Review: Security Reviewer (PR-time, reads PR in context of whole codebase, posts
    ONE review comment) + Vulnerability Scanner (codebase AT REST). Scope: SQL/command/
    template injection, authn/authz bypass, secrets/credentials, SSRF, unsafe
    deserialization, vulnerable dependencies. Custom per-codebase rules. Per-repo enable;
    draft PRs excluded. Docs: cursor.com/docs/security-agents + cursor.com/docs/security-review.
